title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility & high-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi-tiered, low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop full-stack solutions for Cart/Checkout services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.
  
  
**About The Team**
We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Software Engineer - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation & Role:**
You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain production-grade backend services that power Inventory, Promise & Order Fulfilment capabilities. You will work closely with Tech Leads, Product Owners, and Data Engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and low-latency services. You will actively contribute to design decisions, code reviews and mentor junior engineers in the team.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design and operate secure, observable and resilient Java/Spring Boot services and low-latency APIs for inventory availability and order promising with performance suitable for peak and concurrent demand
* Implement robust concurrency-control and consistency patterns to prevent overselling when multiple orders compete for limited inventory.
* Build event-driven inventory processing using Kafka or similar messaging technologies to handle receipts, adjustments, reservations, releases, cancellations, and fulfilment updates in near real time.
* Integrate inventory and promising services with OMS, commerce, WMS, ERP, store, and fulfilment platforms to provide consistent availability across the order lifecycle.
* Independently own complex services or components from technical design through production.
* Write clean, tested and maintainable code, participate in peer reviews, and maintain relevant technical documentation.
* Optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation and proactive improvements.
* Support production services through monitoring, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis contributing to reliability improvements.
* Lead component-level design, document trade-offs and contribute recommendations to team-level architecture decisions.
* Mentor junior engineers, perform code reviews and help establish engineering standards and best practices.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and operating scalable, high-availability, consumer-facing platforms.
* Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures, building scalable, resilient, and production-grade services.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms, with practical experience applying them to real-world use cases.
* Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming platforms for event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise-scale system integrations.
* Deep understanding of caching strategies and hands-on experience with Redis or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of concurrency, consistency, and transactional integrity patterns required to prevent overselling in distributed commerce environments.
* Experience implementing event-driven architectures and designing resilient solutions that maintain accuracy under peak trading and high-volume conditions.
* Experience designing graceful degradation and fallback mechanisms that ensure continuity of commerce operations during downstream system disruptions.
* Strong experience with observability and operational excellence practices, including monitoring, distributed tracing and alerting.
* Understanding of inventory management concepts, order promising and delivery estimation models, including inventory location, fulfilment capacity, carrier constraints, and service-level commitments is highly desirable.
* Experience configuring, customizing, and extending OMS platform capabilities to support complex business requirements and omnichannel commerce use cases is preferred.
* Hands-on experience integrating or configuring Fluent Commerce or a comparable OMS platform such as IBM Sterling OMS, Manhattan Associates, Kibo, Salesforce OMS, or similar technologies will be an advantage.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.

description:

About the Role
  

Workshore is looking for an experienced
**Shopify Developer / Integration Engineer**
to work on technically complex e-commerce projects involving Shopify development, custom applications, APIs, and third-party system integrations.

This is
**not primarily a Shopify theme-development role**
.

We need someone comfortable working beyond the storefront, with hands-on experience building
**Shopify apps, API integrations, web services, and custom e-commerce functionality**
.

You'll work with our technical team on projects where Shopify needs to communicate with existing applications, databases, business systems, and external services.

What You'll Work On

Your responsibilities will include:

* Develop custom Shopify applications and integrations
* Build and maintain integrations between Shopify and external platforms
* Work extensively with Shopify Admin APIs and GraphQL
* Design and consume REST and GraphQL APIs
* Develop secure web APIs and backend services
* Implement Shopify webhooks and event-driven workflows
* Build custom functionality that cannot be handled effectively through existing Shopify apps
* Work with authentication, authorization, and Shopify OAuth flows
* Handle synchronization of products, customers, orders, inventory, and other business data
* Integrate Shopify with existing applications and databases
* Design reliable data flows between Shopify and third-party systems
* Implement error handling, retries, logging, and monitoring for integrations
* Debug API, webhook, application, and data synchronization issues
* Understand Shopify API rate limits and design integrations accordingly
* Work with Shopify metafields, metaobjects and custom data structures
* Support Shopify checkout and customer-account customizations where applicable
* Collaborate with frontend developers when custom storefront functionality is required
* Review existing architecture and recommend appropriate technical approaches
* Document APIs, integrations, data flows, and important architectural decisions.

Core Technical Requirements

We're specifically looking for strong hands-on experience in:

**Shopify Development**

* Shopify app development
* Shopify Admin GraphQL API
* Shopify webhooks
* Shopify OAuth and app authentication
* Shopify CLI and development workflows
* Custom and public Shopify applications
* Metafields and metaobjects
* Shopify Functions and extensions
* Shopify's app and API architecture

**API & Integration Development**

* REST APIs
* GraphQL
* Web API development
* Webhooks
* JSON and structured data
* Authentication and authorization
* Third-party API integrations
* Data synchronization
* Error handling and retry mechanisms
* API security and performance

**Backend Development**

Strong experience with at least one modern backend stack, preferably:

* Node.js / TypeScript

Experience with additional backend technologies such as
**C# / .NET, PHP or Python**
is valuable, particularly when integrating Shopify with existing enterprise applications.

**Development Practices**

* Git and version control
* API testing tools such as Postman
* Environment and secrets management
* Logging and debugging
* Database fundamentals
* Deployment and production troubleshooting
* Writing maintainable and documented code

Shopify Frontend Knowledge

While backend and integration experience is the priority, you should still understand the Shopify storefront environment, including:

* Liquid
* Shopify Online Store 2.0
* JavaScript
* HTML/CSS
* Theme architecture
* Sections and blocks
* Storefront APIs

You don't necessarily need to be our primary UI developer, but you should understand how the storefront, Shopify backend, and custom applications work together.

The Kind of Problems You'll Solve

A typical requirement may involve:

**Shopify ↔ Existing Business Application ↔ External APIs**

For example:

An order is created in Shopify.

The order needs to be sent to an external application through an API.

Customer and product information needs to be mapped between two different data structures.

The external application processes the request and sends updated information back.

Shopify then needs to reflect the updated status or data.

Failures need to be logged and retried without creating duplicate transactions.

We're looking for someone who can think through the
**entire integration architecture**
, not simply make an API request work.

What We're Looking For

You should be able to:

* Understand a business requirement and translate it into a technical solution
* Design integrations before starting development
* Determine when to use Shopify native capabilities, an existing app or custom development
* Read and understand third-party API documentation
* Work with unfamiliar APIs and existing systems
* Debug complex integration and data-flow problems
* Think about scalability, security and maintainability
* Identify edge cases before they become production issues
* Communicate technical decisions clearly to the project team
* Estimate development effort realistically
* Take ownership of your work from development through deployment

Strong Advantages

Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Shopify Plus
* Shopify Functions
* Checkout UI Extensions
* Customer Account Extensions
* Shopify Flow
* Custom Shopify apps
* Node.js / TypeScript
* React / Next.js
* C# / ASP.NET
* SQL / NoSQL databases
* AWS or other cloud infrastructure
* ERP, CRM, PIM or inventory integrations
* High-volume product/order synchronization
* Legacy system integrations
* E-commerce migration projects

What You'll Get

You'll work on Shopify projects where the challenge goes beyond theme configuration and app installation.

You'll get exposure to:

* Complex international e-commerce projects
* Custom Shopify application development
* API-driven integrations
* Existing enterprise and legacy systems
* Architecture and technical problem-solving
* Modern AI-assisted development workflows
* Direct collaboration with Workshore's technical and project teams

For the right person, this role offers the opportunity to take greater ownership of
**Shopify engineering and e-commerce integrations at Workshore**
as we expand this capability.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will own the end-to-end architecture of a layered, event-driven data platform — spanning sourcing, ingestion, entity mastering, a bitemporal golden copy, and an API-first distribution layer — and drive it from vision to production. You will be the senior-most engineering voice on reference data, shaping platform strategy, establishing engineering standards across teams, and partnering with product, data, and infrastructure leaders to deliver a scalable, vendor-agnostic master data capability. The ideal candidate is an expert Python engineer and data architect with deep experience in master data management (MDM) and reference data within the financial industry — including market data and vendor feeds — combined with hands-on experience applying Generative AI to data platforms, distributed data processing, and building reusable, independently scalable platform components.
  
  
We are operating in a 4-day in office, 1-day flexible work arrangement.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture of a layered reference-data platform, defining the contracts between sourcing, ingestion, mastering, golden-copy, and distribution layers so each is independently buildable, deployable, and scalable.
* Set technical direction for entity mastering — standardization, blocking, matching, survivorship, and crosswalk/lineage — designing rules as configuration (data, not code) that scale from exact-match fast paths to full-population fuzzy resolution.
* Architect the durable golden copy: a bitemporal, point-in-time source of truth with match evidence, per-attribute provenance, and a schema-last serving model that adapts to new sources and domains without migration.
* Define the event-driven backbone and cadence model (start-of-day, intraday, end-of-day, and on-demand) enabling batch today and real-time streaming (CDC / Kafka) without re-architecture.
* Design the API-first, self-documenting distribution surface (REST, curated data products, subscriptions) governed by data contracts and consumable by applications, analytics, and AI/agents.
* Drive the platform’s storage and compute strategy over an open lakehouse (Apache Iceberg, Snowflake) and elastic compute (Spark), ensuring an open, vendor-agnostic, no-lock-in foundation.
* Establish engineering standards, reference patterns, and a reusable component library (a layered monorepo) that make capabilities build-once, reuse-everywhere across domains.
* Lead cross-team technical design reviews, resolve the hardest architectural trade-offs, and align engineering execution with the firm’s data strategy.
* Champion data quality, governance, security, entitlements, audit, and observability as first-class, cross-cutting foundations of the platform.
* Mentor senior and staff engineers, grow technical depth across the team, and set the bar for engineering excellence.
* Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate reference-data needs into a durable, scalable platform roadmap.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time as a technical lead or architect of data-intensive platforms.
* Expert-level proficiency in Python for building production services, data pipelines, and platform frameworks.
* Proven experience architecting master data management (MDM) or reference/entity-data systems — entity resolution, survivorship, golden records, crosswalk, and lineage.
* Deep data engineering expertise: data modeling, ETL/ELT design, distributed processing (Spark), and data distribution patterns at scale.
* Hands-on experience designing API-first services and event-driven / streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, CDC).
* Strong command of modern data storage — relational, non-relational, and lakehouse formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) — and SQL.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud-native deployment (containers, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD).
* Deep domain experience with reference and master data in the financial industry — parties / legal entities, instruments, portfolios, and accounts — and the identifier, hierarchy, and cross-referencing challenges specific to it.
* Hands-on experience integrating and mastering market data and vendor/administrator feeds (e.g., Bloomberg, exchange, and fund-servicing sources), including normalization, cross-referencing, and point-in-time handling.
* Practical experience applying Generative AI / LLMs to data platforms — e.g., grounded retrieval over governed data, entity-resolution and data-quality assistance, or AI/agent-ready data access with provenance guarantees.
* A track record of setting technical direction, driving architecture across teams, and mentoring senior engineers.
* Excellent judgment on architectural trade-offs, and the communication skills to align engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with bitemporal / point-in-time data modeling and governed, auditable data systems.
* Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Dagster, Airflow) and lakehouse catalogs (e.g., Polaris, Nessie, Glue).
* Exposure to commercial or vendor MDM/ontology platforms (e.g., Palantir Foundry) and experience integrating them as pluggable engines within an open architecture.
* Experience building agentic workflows or retrieval-augmented systems on top of enterprise data, and familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and grounding techniques.
* Experience with legal-entity identifiers and standards (e.g., LEI, GLEIF) and regulatory reference-data requirements.

title: Technical Engineer
description:
**IG LABS · AN INSIGHT GLOBAL COMPANY**

**Technical/Field Engineer**

Proving Feasibility and Solving the Hardest Problems in the Client's Stack

**Location: India**

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technical/Field Engineer to make IG Labs' Factory and solutions work inside the client's own technology stack. Every client runs a different environment, often complex and highly specialized, and getting our solutions to run inside it takes deep, focused technical expertise. You are the specialist who brings it: you learn a client's stack fast, prove what is possible in it, and solve the hard, stack-specific problems that decide whether a deployment succeeds. This is core delivery engineering, the difference between a solution that ships and one that stalls.

You are the engine of feasibility. When the team needs to know whether something can actually be done in a client's environment, you build the experiment or proof-of-concept that answers it, fast, before anyone commits to a path that will not hold. And when an engagement hits a problem that needs deep, methodical debugging, the kind that takes real expertise and patience to unwind, that is your work to own. You also own how a deployment satisfies the client's security and governance requirements, so what proves feasible is also safe to put into production.

You are a distinct category in our delivery model. You are not the Solution Architect who sets the high-level design, the Technical Architect who owns the lower-level architecture, or the Forward Deployed Engineer who builds and deploys across the engagement. You bring depth where they bring breadth: the specific, hard-won command of a client's technology that an engagement lives or dies on. You are a senior engineer in our delivery organization, based in India, working within the POD model alongside the SAs, TAs, FDEs, and the Data and UI/UX engineers who build the rest of the system.

Everything you learn, you make reusable. The integration patterns, environment playbooks, and feasibility findings you produce become Factory IP, so the next time we meet a stack like this one, we start ahead instead of from scratch.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Proving Feasibility**

* Build the experiments and proofs-of-concept that establish whether an approach can actually work in a client's environment, before the team commits to it.
* De-risk engagements early: turn an open technical question into a clear, evidence-backed yes or no, fast.
* Spike the unknowns in a new stack and report back what is possible, what is hard, and what to avoid.
* Give the Solution Architects, Technical Architects, and Forward Deployed Engineers the feasibility signal they need to scope and plan with confidence.

**Deep Technical Problem-Solving**

* Master unfamiliar client technology stacks quickly, becoming the engagement's depth on the client's specific systems and technologies.
* Figure out how to deploy IG Labs' Factory and solutions inside the client's specific environment, with its integrations and constraints and all.
* Own the hard, methodical debugging: the integration, compatibility, environment, and performance problems that take real expertise and patience to unwind.
* Persist where others stall, and stay with a problem until it is genuinely solved, not worked around.

**Security & Governance**

* Own the security and governance of our AI deployments: how the system handles data, access, and secrets, and the controls an enterprise requires.
* Make sure deployments meet the client's security posture and the regulatory constraints of their industry, with particular care in financial services and healthcare.
* Put the right controls around agentic systems: data protection and PII handling, access and permissions, audit and lineage, and the guardrails that keep autonomy within policy.
* Work with the client's security and compliance teams to get solutions approved and into production without cutting corners.

**Delivering in Client Engagements**

* Work as a peer to the Solution Architects, Technical Architects, and Forward Deployed Engineers in the POD, bringing the depth they rely on but do not carry themselves.
* Own your work end to end, from a hard technical question to a proven, working result the engagement can build on.
* Maintain the documentation and handoff discipline that distributed, multi-client delivery requires, so what you prove and solve is easy to pick up and reuse.
* Be available for the hard, real-time problems that need a working session, not a write-up.

**Building Reusable Capability**

* Turn everything you learn into reusable capability: integration patterns, environment playbooks, and feasibility findings that make the next engagement on a similar stack faster.
* Partner with the Technical Architect to abstract, validate, and document what you produce for the IP library.
* Actively drive Reuse Index, so the next time we meet a stack like this one, we start ahead instead of from scratch.
* Treat capability-building as core, not overhead. Every hard problem solved should leave the Factory stronger.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a Solution Architect. The SA sets the high-level solution design; you prove it can be built in the client's environment and make it work there.
* Not a Technical Architect. The TA owns the lower-level architecture and standards; you bring the deep, stack-specific expertise that turns architecture into something that runs.
* Not a Forward Deployed Engineer. The FDE builds and deploys across the engagement with broad range; you go deep on the client's specific technology and the hardest technical problems. Breadth and depth, side by side.
* Not a pre-sales or demo role. You are an engineer who proves feasibility with real code and solves real problems, not slideware.
* Not a support desk or ticket queue. You take the hard, novel technical problems, not routine requests.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

8+ years in a deeply technical engineering role (solutions engineering, platform or systems engineering, complex integration, or similar), with a track record of going into unfamiliar technology and making it work. Fast at learning new stacks, frameworks, and platforms to real depth. Exceptional at debugging hard, ambiguous problems methodically. Comfortable building proofs-of-concept quickly to prove or disprove an approach. Strong across the modern stack: cloud, APIs and integration, data, and the systems clients actually run. A solid command of security and governance in enterprise deployments: access control, data protection, audit, and compliance. A clear written communicator who collaborates well across a distributed team.

**Strongly Preferred**

Experience deploying software into enterprise client environments, especially regulated ones in financial services or healthcare. Breadth across multiple clouds and a wide range of technologies and languages. Experience with AI and agentic systems (LLM orchestration, RAG, agent runtimes). A consulting, professional services, or client-delivery background. Experience with AI governance and responsible-AI controls (guardrails, PII handling, model and data governance) and with security reviews in regulated environments. A reputation as the person teammates bring their hardest problems to.

title: Founding Security Engineer (AI & Privacy) – Ozyn.AI
description:
Ozyn.AI is an AI assistant that works across people’s email, calendar, documents and messages, and takes actions on their behalf. People will only let an assistant into their lives if they trust it completely. Your job is to make Ozyn worth that trust.

**About the role**

**You’ll be our first security hire, working directly with the CEO and the engineering team. You won’t be writing policies from the sidelines. You’ll review code, change the architecture, build the protections, and own security and privacy for Ozyn end to end.**

**What you’ll do**

* **Secure the agent:**
  design defences against prompt injection, unsafe tool use and data leakage, so that content in a user’s email or documents can never make Ozyn act against them.
* **Protect connected accounts:**
  own how OAuth tokens and permissions for Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook and other integrations are requested, stored, scoped, rotated and revoked.
* **Keep user data separate:**
  guarantee one user’s data can never reach another user, across databases, caches, vector stores, logs and model prompts.
* **Encrypt and minimise:**
  set up encryption at rest and in transit, key management and secrets handling. Keep personal data out of places it doesn’t need to be.
* **Build privacy into the product:**
  data minimisation, retention and deletion, consent, and handling users’ requests to see or delete their data, in line with India’s DPDP Act and global norms.
* **Review and test:**
  threat-model new features, review pull requests, run security testing, and set up security checks in CI/CD.
* **Detect and respond:**
  set up logging, monitoring and alerting, an audit trail of every action the agent takes, and an incident response plan.
* **Prepare for enterprise buyers:**
  lead our path to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 and answer customer security questionnaires.
* **Raise the bar:**
  teach the engineering team secure defaults so security doesn’t depend on one person.

**What we’re looking for**

* 4–8 years in application, cloud or product security, with real hands-on engineering. You can read and write production code.
* Experience securing a product that handles sensitive personal data, ideally as an early or sole security owner at a startup.
* Strong grasp of OAuth, identity and access management, cloud security (AWS or GCP), secrets and key management, and secure architecture.
* Practical understanding of how LLM applications fail: prompt injection, unsafe tool calling, data leakage through context and logs.
* Sound judgement: you know which risks matter now and which can wait, and you can explain trade-offs clearly to founders and engineers.

**Bonus**

* Bug bounty findings, published security advisories, talks, write-ups or open-source security tools.
* Experience taking a company through SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* Familiarity with India’s DPDP Act, GDPR or similar privacy rules.

**Why join**

* Define security for an AI assistant from day one, as the person responsible for it.
* Work directly with the CEO in a small, fast-moving team.
* Grow into leading security as Ozyn scales.

title: Associate Director, Software Architecture
description:
**About Us**
Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Technical Architect who is currently active in hands-on engineering and brings deep expertise across messaging systems, Java-based backend technologies, large-scale distributed architecture, and modern cloud-native delivery. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of architecture and engineering — capable of drawing design blueprints in the morning and writing production code or conducting a proof of concept in the afternoon.
  
  
This is a practitioner-first role. You will be expected to make informed architectural decisions grounded in proven patterns, lead by example in technical execution, and mentor engineering teams through complex design and delivery challenges. You should be comfortable using AI/LLM tools in your day-to-day work and have the ability to quickly understand, learn, and implement AI-enabled solutions where they add clear value.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Hands-On Architecture & Design
  
  

* Design and evolve large-scale, distributed systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance, including AI/LLM-enabled components where appropriate.
* Make well-reasoned architectural decisions based on proven patterns such as Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, Saga, Circuit Breaker, and API Gateway, and apply similar rigor to AI integrations (guardrails, fallbacks, observability).
* Create clear architecture blueprints, sequence diagrams, and technical specifications to guide engineering teams, including designs for services that interact with LLM APIs or AI workflows.
* Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and sprint ceremonies to ensure architectural alignment, and leverage AI tools to accelerate reviews, refactoring, and documentation where suitable

Messaging & Integration Systems
  
  

* Design and implement messaging solutions using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, and ActiveMQ.
* Leverage Apache Camel for enterprise integration patterns, routing, and transformation pipelines, including integration with AI/LLM services where relevant.
* Ensure high-throughput, fault-tolerant messaging architectures that meet SLA requirements.
* Evaluate and recommend the right messaging technology based on use-case, volume, and latency requirements.

Software Engineering (Java & Spring Ecosystem)
  
  

* Develop and review production-quality code in Java and Spring Boot, leading by technical example, and use AI/LLM tools to assist with boilerplate, tests, and refactoring while maintaining high quality.
* Champion microservices best practices including API design, service decomposition, and inter-service communication, including secure and observable integration with AI services.
* Conduct and lead Proof of Concepts (POCs) for evaluating new frameworks, libraries, and technologies.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices, including safe and responsible use of AI-generated code and suggestions.

Containerization, Kubernetes & Cloud
  
  

* Design and oversee containerized deployment strategies using Docker and Kubernetes (K8s).
* Manage workload orchestration, autoscaling, resource quotas, and namespace design on Kubernetes clusters.
* Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to build robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, incorporating AI-enabled tooling to improve productivity and reliability.
* Ensure container security, network policies, and secrets management are baked into the architecture.

Observability & Performance Monitoring
  
  

* Establish and embed observability frameworks covering distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics collection.
* Define performance monitoring and alerting standards across services and infrastructure.
* Conduct performance profiling and tuning of Java applications including JVM, heap, and GC optimization.
* Lead performance benchmarking exercises and resolve bottlenecks in high-traffic, latency-sensitive systems.

Memory Management & Performance Tuning
  
  

* Demonstrate deep expertise in JVM memory management — heap sizing, GC strategies, metaspace, and memory leak analysis.
* Utilize profiling tools (e.g., JProfiler, VisualVM, async-profiler) to diagnose and resolve performance issues.
* Tune application performance at the code, runtime, and infrastructure levels.
* Define best practices for resource utilization and memory-efficient programming patterns.

Database Architecture (RDBMS & NoSQL)
  
  

* Design relational data models and optimize queries for PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.
* Architect NoSQL solutions using MongoDB including schema design, indexing strategies, and aggregation pipelines.
* Define data access patterns, connection pooling strategies, and caching layers.
* Ensure data consistency, integrity, and resilience across distributed data stores.

Proof of Concepts & Innovation
  
  

* Proactively identify technology gaps and propose PoCs to validate architectural decisions before broader adoption, including AI/LLM-based approaches where they can improve productivity, reliability, or customer outcomes.
* Work hands-on with engineering teams during PoC phases to prototype and evaluate solutions.
* Translate PoC outcomes into actionable architectural recommendations and implementation roadmaps.

What You Bring
  
  
Must-Haves
  
  

* 12 to 16 years of progressive hands-on experience in software engineering with a strong architecture track record.
* Currently active in coding and engineering — not purely a management or advisory role.
* Demonstrable expertise in Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, and Apache Camel.
* Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for building enterprise-grade microservices and APIs.
* Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems that handle high volumes and strict SLAs.
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization including production cluster operations.
* Expertise in observability practices — distributed tracing (e.g., Jaeger, Zipkin), logging (ELK/EFK), and metrics (Prometheus/Grafana).
* Strong understanding of JVM internals, memory management, and performance tuning techniques.
* Solid experience with both RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).
* Ability to make architecture decisions grounded in established patterns and proven engineering principles.
* Experience conducting and leading Proof of Concepts (PoCs) end-to-end.
* Comfortable using AI/LLM tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in day-to-day work for design, coding, reviews, documentation, and debugging.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand, learn, and implement AI/LLM-based solutions and integrate them pragmatically into enterprise architectures when they add clear value.

Nice-to-Haves
  
  

* Experience in payments, financial messaging, or regulated financial technology platforms.
* Exposure to event sourcing, stream processing (e.g., Kafka Streams, Apache Flink).
* Experience with chaos engineering and resilience testing practices.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs or using AI frameworks (e.g., Spring AI, LangChain4j, or similar) in Java-based systems.
* Familiarity with vector databases or vector search (e.g., pgvector, Weaviate, Pinecone, Milvus) and RAG patterns.
* Exposure to responsible-AI practices in production (data governance, auditability, cost/latency monitoring, human-in-the-loop where needed).

What We Offer

**THE TEAM & THE JOB**
The Enterprise Systems BI Data & Analytics team owns the design, delivery and governance of YouGov's Power BI reporting and analytics estate, built on the Microsoft Fabric platform. Following an investment in internal capability, the team is building out its in-house engineering and development resource under the Enterprise Systems Senior Manager BI Data & Analytics.
  
  
As Senior Data Engineer, you will be an advanced-level professional responsible for the data pipelines, models and Fabric architecture that underpin the company's reporting and analytics. You will work autonomously on complex data engineering assignments, determine methods and procedures on new work, provide technical direction and mentoring to more junior engineers.

* Build and maintain data warehouse, data lake and lakehouse architectures within the Fabric ecosystem, implementing OneLake integration patterns.
* Develop and optimise semantic models for performance and scalability, applying DAX and data-model best practices.

* Extensive experience in data engineering or related roles.
* Hands-on Power BI experience, including advanced DAX, Power Query (M), data modelling/star schema design, Power BI Service administration and Premium/Fabric capacity management.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, or comparable experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory or Databricks.

title: SAP Systems Analyst
description:
The SAP Systems Analyst is the hands-on technical owner of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. This position bridges the gap between technical data management and functional system design.

The role combines the finance core (general ledger, close support, procure-to-pay, and user provisioning) with integration, data, and cloud administration work. The role works closely with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to design, configure, and document new system functionalities, ensuring our SAP platform evolves to meet growing business needs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

System Design, Integration, and Extensibility (approx. 30%)

* Design, build, and operate integrations between S/4HANA Public Cloud and the broader landscape (billing, expense management, banks, payroll, and others) using SAP Integration Suite and SAP-delivered APIs.
* Build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP (SAP Build, CAP, SAPUI5/Fiori) and in-app extensions (custom fields, logic, CDS views, ABAP Cloud where permitted). Follow clean-core principles and use released APIs only.
* Automate repetitive finance processes with SAP Build Process Automation (BPA) where it fits.
* Gather and document business requirements with finance and business users, translate them into functional and technical specifications and standard SAP configuration.
* Create and maintain documentation for architecture, configurations, data flows, and runbooks.
* Take part in unit and integration testing of new configurations and developments; identify opportunities for optimization and process improvement.

Finance Systems, Close, and Procure-to-Pay (approx. 25%)

* Configure GL accounts for the company codes, and manage the chart of accounts, ledgers, currencies, fiscal calendars, and multi-entity and intercompany structures.
* Support period-end and year-end close, including the advanced financial close and reconciliation tools.
* Review billing and payment feed exceptions and confirm that customer invoices and payments tie to the GL and open items.
* Configure suppliers using SAP Build Process Automation (BPA), and support purchase requisitions and orders, invoice verification, inventory management, and supplier master data.
* Partner with Accounting to validate migrated balances and sign off the results.

Data Management and Integrity (approx. 25%)

* Support the transition of customer line items, AR aging, and deferred revenue from legacy billing systems into SAP, and validate the migrated balances.
* Convert legacy billing calculations into SQL data pipelines and automate monthly line-item reconciliation (for example, in Python).
* Own the interface between the billing system, the intermediary SQL database, and SAP. Build automated completeness checks that compare record counts, totals, and document numbers across billing, SQL, and SAP, and report and reload any missing records.
* Oversee and refine existing data transformation (ETL) processes, particularly for the monthly financial close, to keep data accurate and on time.
* Analyze and map data flows between SAP and other integrated business systems.
* Support data governance by helping define and enforce data standards in SAP.

System Governance, User Access, Cloud Administration, and Support (approx. 20%)

* Own user provisioning: new users, changes, and terminations, including business role assignment and timely removal of access. Maintain security roles, and support periodic access reviews and audit requests.
* Manage Central Business Configuration (CBC), Cloud Connector, and BTP Cockpit integrations.
* Manage communication arrangements, communication systems, credentials, and certificate renewals; monitor message flows and resolve failures.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for end-user support and resolve issues.
* Assist with change control and configuration promotion between test and production tenants.
* Support SAP release and patch cycles, including reviewing release notes, regression testing, and sign-off before production.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
* 5+ years in SAP systems analysis, enterprise integration, or development, with 2+ years on S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO) and strong accounting fundamentals, including general ledger, close, and reconciliation processes.

The architect defines the event log architecture, ERP data extraction strategy, pipeline reliability, platform administration, and the technical standards that enable scalable, accurate, and audit‑ready process insights. Upon SI handover, this role leads the maintenance, evolution, and scaling of the Celonis platform independently.

* Define and maintain the enterprise event log architecture, object‑centric data models (OCDM), Perspectives, and Knowledge Model that enable process mining, conformance analysis, variant detection, and KPI measurement across enterprise processes. Own the technical design decisions that determine how business objects, events, and relationships are modeled within the platform (25%).
* Own the end‑to‑end data integration strategy from source ERP systems (Oracle JDE) into the Celonis platform, including connector configuration, extraction method selection (JDBC, REST, batch vs. real‑time), transformation scripts (PQL), data integration scheduling, and pipeline orchestration. Define acceptance criteria for event logs and analytical assets before publication to business stakeholders (10%).
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Process Intelligence Data Engineer (P3), Senior Analyst, Process Excellence (P3), and broader Pune BPM execution team. Define technical standards, conduct architecture reviews, establish reusable templates and patterns, and ensure alignment with Edwards enterprise IT governance and security requirements (10%).
* Evaluate and recommend adoption paths for emerging Celonis capabilities (e.g., Process Sphere, Action Flows, AgentC, AI‑driven insights) aligned to Edwards’ process intelligence roadmap. Configure and validate execution solutions including Action Flows and Business Apps for prioritized value opportunities (5%).

* 8+ years of experience in data architecture, solution architecture, or analytics platform architecture roles.

* Strong expertise in SQL, relational database design, and ERP data schemas (Oracle JDE, SAP, or equivalent).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT data pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define data governance frameworks, quality standards, and architectural documentation.
* Experience with platform administration including SSO, user provisioning, and role‑based access control.
* Ability to lead technical delivery in a global, matrixed organization and serve as a technical mentor for colleagues with less experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
* High level of independence, sound judgment, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, greenfield environments.

title: Deployment Engineer
description:
Zero Forg turns the CCTV cameras already in factories and warehouses into a real-time safety, security and operations

layer. Every site runs an AI server on the premises, connected to the site's cameras. The Deployment Engineer takes

that server from a blank machine to a live, monitored system.

**Responsibilities**

**Area Details**

**Working with Linux**
Run Ubuntu servers and NVIDIA Jetson devices from the terminal: users and SSH keys,

systemd services, logs (journalctl), disks, permissions and updates. Find out why a

service stopped and bring it back.

**Installing the OS**
Install Ubuntu on GPU workstations and flash JetPack on Jetsons. Set BIOS/UEFI

correctly (storage mode, boot order, dual boot), install NVIDIA drivers and CUDA, and

verify the GPU with nvidia-smi.

**Docker-based systems**
Deploy and update services as containers with Docker and Docker Compose, give them

GPU access (NVIDIA Container Toolkit), read container logs, keep data on volumes, and

roll back to the previous version.

**Scripting**
Run, read and fix Bash and Python scripts for installs, health checks and log collection.

Follow install runbooks step by step and improve them.

**Checking connections**
Get every camera talking to the server: IP plan, DHCP reservations, PoE switches, NVR

access, RTSP streams (ffprobe, VLC). Trace an offline camera to the camera, cable,

switch, site internet or DNS using ping, traceroute and nmap. Set up and check remote

access (Tailscale, SSH).

**Site deployment**
Install the server at customer sites, test every camera stream, confirm remote access

before leaving, hand over to the customer and write an install report.

**Requirements**

**Area Details**

**Experience**
1-3 years of hands-on work with Linux servers

**Operating systems**
Has installed an OS from scratch and recovered a machine that would not boot

**Containers**
Docker in regular use: images, containers, Compose, logs, volumes

**Scripting**
Bash; Python is a strong plus

**Networking**
IP addressing, subnets, DHCP, DNS, ports, VPNs

**Edge hardware**
NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, GPU workstations

**CCTV**
CCTV and NVR setup (Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus), RTSP and ONVIF

**Remote access and tools**
Tailscale or WireGuard, SSH tunnels, Git

**Travel**
Willing to travel to factory and warehouse sites

**Bonus**

**Area Details**

**Industrial protocols**
Modbus (RTU and TCP), OPC UA, MQTT, and other industrial or IoT protocols

**Robotics**
ROS / ROS 2: nodes, topics, launch files, working with robot hardware.

title: Data and AI Delivery Leader
description:
**Workplace:**
Remote (India), periodic onsite for kickoffs

**About the role**

Networth Corp builds data and AI systems for enterprise clients. Real production systems, not slideware.

We're a young firm, scaling deliberately, with a small team that punches well above its weight. You'll work alongside people who genuinely know their craft: data engineers who understand what fails in production, ML engineers who care about evaluation, ontology architects who've built at scale. You'll learn faster here in a year than you will in three at a Big-4 practice.

This role owns delivery health across data and AI engagements. You'll partner with a Senior Engagement Architect as a two-in-a-box on each account. One owns the engagement contract and commercial health. You own execution and delivery health. Your partner will bring you into steering committees, client difficult conversations, and commercial negotiations until you can run them yourself. We coach.

You'll also stay close to the actual work. Close enough to open a notebook when a pipeline is behind, walk a Spark job log, spot a DAX measure that's silently wrong, look at an LLM eval report and know if it's telling you the truth. Not to do the engineers' jobs. To know when something's off before they tell you.

Why this is a great next move

* **You'll ship things that matter.**
  Our clients are Fortune 500 chemicals, life sciences, financial services, and manufacturing firms. What you deliver runs in their actual operations
* **You'll own real scope from day one.**
  Small firm, high trust. No waiting three years for a promotion to touch a real client
* **You'll be around people who care about craft.**
  Design system enforced. Standards enforced. Retros that actually change how we work
* **You'll be coached, not micromanaged.**
  Two-in-a-box partners bring you into hard conversations early so you learn by being in the room
* **You'll grow into a Senior Delivery Leader role.**
  With mentorship, portfolio experience, and delivery contributions on your record

What you'll do

* Own delivery quality across one or more data and AI engagements as capacity builds
* Run the delivery cadence: sprint planning, standups, reviews, retros, milestone tracking, dependency management, escalation
* Stay close to the work: read pipeline logs, open the notebook, look at the model card, review the eval report, poke at the dashboard yourself. Show up to squad standups where it matters
* Enforce Networth Corp's delivery process. Quality gates (DoR, DoD, data quality gates, model release readiness), artifacts that get used (RAID logs, decision logs, ADRs, data contracts), governance rhythms
* Enforce design standards on every client-facing artifact. Ugly slides and cluttered dashboards do not leave the building
* Contribute to the knowledge management loop: retros, playbook updates, template refinements, prompt libraries, evaluation harnesses, ontology patterns
* Partner with the Senior Engagement Architect on client health, escalations, and steering committee prep. Grow into leading these yourself
* Coordinate fractional leads and IC teams across data engineering, ML, LLM/GenAI, ontology, BI, integration, and platform workstreams
* Show up in client working groups and squad syncs. Learn to hold steering committee conversations with CIO, CDO, and CTO stakeholders. Your Engagement Architect partner brings you into these until you're ready to run them
* Watch for risk proactively: model risk, data quality risk, dependency risk. Flag drift the week it starts
* Track commercial hygiene: burn versus forecast, utilisation, invoice cleanness, change requests before scope creeps

How we work

* **Process is a product.**
  We treat our delivery methodology like software we ship. Versioned, tested, improved every release
* **Design is not decoration.**
  Every deliverable follows a house design system
* **Knowledge compounds.**
  Every engagement ends with a documented handover, and every playbook cites the engagement that hardened it
* **Culture over process, when they conflict.**
  We hold each other to high standards and to kindness in the same sentence. Direct feedback, no politics, no BS
* **We coach.**
  You'll pair with senior delivery people on the harder stuff. Nobody expects you to walk in knowing how to run a bad-quarter steering committee. We expect you to want to learn

What you'll work with

* **Client stacks**
  : Databricks · Snowflake · Microsoft Fabric · Azure ML · Bedrock · Azure OpenAI · SAP · Salesforce · dbt · Airflow · Kafka
* **Data and AI delivery patterns**
  : data contracts · data product thinking · MLOps release cadence · LLMOps evaluation gates · Unity Catalog governance · lineage-first delivery
* **Delivery frameworks**
  : Scrum, Kanban. SAFe patterns if you've seen them
* **Tools you'll use daily**
  : Jira · Confluence · Notion · Miro · Loom · Slack · Teams
* **Tools you'll open when the team is stuck**
  : Databricks notebooks · dbt Cloud · Airflow UI · MLflow · LangSmith or Langfuse for LLM traces · Power BI Desktop · DAX Studio

What we're looking for

* 2 to 6 years in delivery leadership, project management, tech lead, or an engineering role you're moving out of into delivery
* This opportunity is ideal for up-and-coming managers who are ready to take the next step in their leadership journey and grow into a Delivery Manager role
* You've shipped data or AI to production. Even if you were part of the team, not leading it. You know what it takes because you've done it
* You still open the tools yourself: read a Spark plan, walk a notebook, look at a dbt run, spot a bad DAX measure, review an LLM eval report. You don't have to write the fix. You have to see the problem
* Comfortable in modern data and AI stacks: Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, Azure, or similar. You've used them, not just heard of them
* Comfortable running Scrum or Kanban cadence: standups, planning, retros, tracking
* Client-comfortable: you can hold a working group conversation with data product owners and tech leads. You want to grow toward CIO and CDO conversations
* Process orientation: you like standards and playbooks. You don't resent them
* Design taste: opinions about what a good deck looks like, and you're willing to enforce them
* Knowledge management instinct: first thing you do after a milestone is write up what happened, and put it somewhere findable
* Comfort with the ambiguity of a scaling firm. This is not a Big-4 role with a 30-page methodology to hide behind

Bonus

* Started as a data engineer, ML engineer, analytics engineer, or BI developer before moving into delivery. Huge plus
* Contributed to a GenAI or agent platform in production
* Delivery experience in regulated industries (chemicals, pharma, financial services, life sciences)
* Familiar with modern engagement models (T&M, outcomes-based, staff-plus-IP bundles)
* Contributed to a team's playbook, methodology, or design system as a named author
* Certifications welcome, never required: Databricks, Azure, PMI-ACP, PSM, SAFe

Data and AI Delivery · Delivery Management · Project Management · Databricks Delivery · MLOps Delivery · Agile Delivery · Scrum · Kanban · Data Engineering · Machine Learning · GenAI · Power BI · dbt · Client Relationship Management · Team Coordination · Risk Management · Knowledge Management
